notes.title: Hop Step Sing! Steam debut & second single release!
notes.notes:
The fans have been waiting, and now they're finally here!
Get ready to meet Niina Nijikawa, Mikasa Minowa and Shikiri Shiishiba: the members of Hop Step Sing!

Not only do we have their debut single, you can also enjoy their second single, 
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/646530]kiss×kiss×kiss[/url] too!

And if you want to enjoy both songs, we've even started a [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3859/Hop_Step_Sing_Fan_Club/]fan club[/url] for you!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26964293/8140eacca7c26f0a2c9e751a960ce2346e220e4c.jpg[/img]

Look forward to hearing more about them in the future!
